brief: Query raw key level or a latched press while updating latch bits.
decl: std::uint32_t input_key_query(std::span<const std::byte, 128> keys, std::span<std::byte> latches, std::uint32_t code, std::uint32_t press_only);

bookkeeping.scope: Complete original body with actual raw key child and no substituted dependencies.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Nonnegative code inside a caller-owned latch window disjoint from the read-only 128-byte key image. The raw child accepts the code and the full 32-bit press-only argument is tested for zero. Original latch faults and accesses below the latch base are outside the contract.
bookkeeping.acceptance: Met: 1472 complete original-body cases exact on MSVC and Zig/Clang, with no input substitutions. Six connected query/release traces also match. See docs/recovery/input-key-state.md.
unresolved: Original key-state producers, hardware polling, and complete camera-handler integration.
Original latch accesses outside supplied window and fault behavior.
